SELECT DISTINCT je.value AS v
       FROM report_index ri JOIN report r ON r.id=ri.report_id AND r.status='done', json_each(ri.source_ids) je
       WHERE je.value IS NOT NULL AND je.value <> '' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provenance_redaction pr WHERE pr.scope='report'
    AND pr.entity_key='report:' || ri.report_id
    AND (julianday(pr.effective_at) IS NULL OR julianday(pr.effective_at)<=julianday('now'))) ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM integrity_report_lifecycle irl WHERE irl.tenant_id='default' AND irl.report_id=ri.report_id AND irl.reader_state <> 'active')
       ORDER BY je.value

SELECT report_index.*, snippet(report_fts, 3, '', '', '…', 12) AS _snippet
      FROM report_index JOIN report_fts ON report_fts.report_id = report_index.report_id
      WHERE report_fts MATCH ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM report r WHERE r.id=report_index.report_id AND r.status='done') AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provenance_redaction pr WHERE pr.scope='report'
    AND pr.entity_key='report:' || report_index.report_id
    AND (julianday(pr.effective_at) IS NULL OR julianday(pr.effective_at)<=julianday('now'))) ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM integrity_report_lifecycle irl WHERE irl.tenant_id='default' AND irl.report_id=report_index.report_id AND irl.reader_state <> 'active')
      ORDER BY bm25(report_fts) ASC LIMIT 100
